description:
Get total open interest in perpetual futures for any asset, with 1h and 24h change rates. Pairs with funding_rates to complete the derivatives picture — rising OI with high funding = overcrowded position.

Use when: You need to know total open interest in perpetual futures and whether it's rising or falling. Combine with funding_rates for a full derivatives picture.
Returns: total_oi_usd, oi_change_1h_pct, oi_change_24h_pct, long_short_ratio, per-exchange breakdown
Example response: {"asset":"ETH","price_usd":2069.73,"total_oi_usd":8420000000,"oi_change_1h_pct":1.2,"oi_change_24h_pct":12.4,"long_short_ratio":1.08,"exchanges":[{"exchange":"Binance","oi_contracts":4066123.5,"oi_change_1h_pct":1.2,"oi_change_24h_pct":12.4,"long_short_ratio":1.08}],"source":"binance/bybit"}

Price: $0.000 USDC per call
name: open_interest
